name: cache-maxxing
description: Shows how long Claude's chat memory (prompt cache) stays active and what your next message costs, and compacts big unfinished chats on its own before that memory expires

rebuildLimitUsd.title: Rebuild limit ($)
rebuildLimitUsd.description: Above this rebuild cost, the bar suggests a new chat instead of carrying on.

warnMinutes.title: Warning time (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: How early the bar turns yellow before the chat memory expires (1-hour memory only; the 5-minute memory never turns yellow).

longChatTokens.title: Long chat size (tokens)
longChatTokens.description: Chat size at which the bar suggests starting a new chat after the current task.

costStyle.title: Show cost as
costStyle.description: dollars shows approximate $ amounts; times shows how many times more than a normal message.

memoryMinutes.title: Memory time
memoryMinutes.description: auto follows each reply (1 hour on a subscription, 5 minutes with an API key or usage credits); 5 or 60 force it.

autoCompact.title: Auto-compact
autoCompact.description: on compacts a big, unfinished chat by itself shortly before its chat memory expires, or when your usage limit is nearly reached. off never does.

autoCompactMinutes.title: Auto-compact: minutes left
autoCompactMinutes.description: How many minutes before the chat memory expires an unfinished chat is compacted.

autoCompactLimitPercent.title: Auto-compact: usage limit (%)
autoCompactLimitPercent.description: At this much of your 5-hour or weekly usage limit, unfinished chats are compacted at once, while their memory is still active.
